1: Truth does not bend to match the mood of the age.
2: Conviction keeps a soul anchored when opinions start drifting.
3: Stand where truth stands, even when applause disappears.
4: A clear conscience is worth more than public approval.
5: Truth is not harsh because it refuses to flatter error.
6: Conviction is what remains when convenience is removed.
7: You do not protect truth by softening it into something else.

11: If God has spoken, silence is not neutrality.
12: Conviction turns belief from a slogan into a backbone.
